title: Introduction To General Agriculture I
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very hard crop, adapted to a wide range of soil."
Cowpea is a very hard crop, adapted to a wide range of soil.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most important factors of agricultural production."
Land is one of the most important factors of agricultural production.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a member of the family Moraceae."
The rubber plant is a member of the family Moraceae.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used manly as building material."
Timber is used manly as building material.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an advanced stage of study undertaken to discover or establish facts or principles."
Research is an advanced stage of study undertaken to discover or establish facts or principles.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used as condiments for the preparation of stews, soups and for preparing curry powders for seasoning foods."
Peppers are used as condiments for the preparation of stews, soups and for preparing curry powders for seasoning foods.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as fixed sequence of growing different crops on one field at different times."
Crop rotation can be defined as fixed sequence of growing different crops on one field at different times.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the period from germination to harvesting."
Life cycle is the period from germination to harvesting.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the various method used by different groups of people for producing crops and livestock in order to supply human needs."
Agricultural systems are the various method used by different groups of people for producing crops and livestock in order to supply human needs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the strict adherence to the land use decree of 1978 as amended by the 1990 Act."
The only solution is the strict adherence to the land use decree of 1978 as amended by the 1990 Act.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the way land is owned in a society."
Land tenure is the way land is owned in a society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important source of vitamin A, which is required for the normal functioning of the human eye."
Carotene is an important source of vitamin A, which is required for the normal functioning of the human eye.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used for salad, vegetables and in canning industries."
The fruits of tomatoes are used for salad, vegetables and in canning industries.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the cardinal objectives of a nation, especially Nigeria."
Self-sufficiency in food production is one of the cardinal objectives of a nation, especially Nigeria.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as a voluntary out-of-school educational arrangement created to increase the production capacity, and thus, the standard of living of the rural and urban populace."
Extension service is defined as a voluntary out-of-school educational arrangement created to increase the production capacity, and thus, the standard of living of the rural and urban populace.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most important root crops."
Yam is one of the most important root crops.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the necessary conditions for the development of agriculture."
Agricultural extension is one of the necessary conditions for the development of agriculture.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a form of staple food for most Nigerians and farm animals."
Grains are a form of staple food for most Nigerians and farm animals.
fib: ______ can be defined as the loose material covering the surface of the earth which supports life and is the basis of farming.
Soil
Soil can be defined as the loose material covering the surface of the earth which supports life and is the basis of farming.
______ are those that starts flowering when the length of day is short e.g. okra (Hibiscus esculentus).
Short-day plants
Short-day plants are those that starts flowering when the length of day is short e.g. okra (Hibiscus esculentus).
______ is a function of some institutional constraints.
under-utilisation of land
The under-utilisation of land is a function of some institutional constraints.
______ is a natural body consisting of layers or horizons of minerals which differ in their characteristic, physical, chemical and mineralogical components.
soil itself
The soil itself is a natural body consisting of layers or horizons of minerals which differ in their characteristic, physical, chemical and mineralogical components.
______ are those with relatively high educational background, good past farming performance and are able to command the respect of their contemporaries.
Contact farmers
Contact farmers are those with relatively high educational background, good past farming performance and are able to command the respect of their contemporaries.
______ are those which are cultivated for their seeds.
Cereal crops or grain crops
Cereal crops or grain crops are those which are cultivated for their seeds.
______ is a subject/course with a wide range of activities.
Agriculture
Agriculture is a subject/course with a wide range of activities.
______ are used for clearing the farm.
Bulldozers
Bulldozers are used for clearing the farm.
______ are the target of cooperative extension officers and agricultural extension officers.
Farmers
Farmers are the target of cooperative extension officers and agricultural extension officers.

______ are the most important cereals of warm temperature zones; while in the tropical regions of the world, rice, maize, guinea com and the millet form the bulk of the diet of large sections of communities.
Wheat and barley

Wheat and barley are the most important cereals of warm temperature zones; while in the tropical regions of the world, rice, maize, guinea com and the millet form the bulk of the diet of large sections of communities.
______ are the dominant cereals of the colder regions of the world.
Oats
Oats are the dominant cereals of the colder regions of the world.
______ is the early maturing ones which complete their life cycle within 60-72 days.
short-day variety
The short-day variety is the early maturing ones which complete their life cycle within 60-72 days.
______ is a blessing to agriculture, but it has disadvantages and limitations.
Mechanisation
Mechanisation is a blessing to agriculture, but it has disadvantages and limitations.
______ is used much more effectively. e.
Labour
Labour is used much more effectively. e.
______ is an essential practice after transplanting.
Weeding
Weeding is an essential practice after transplanting.
______ is the gradual transition from rainforest vegetation, through wood land to savanna vegetation.
Associated with this change
Associated with this change is the gradual transition from rainforest vegetation, through wood land to savanna vegetation.
______ is a method being employed to check desert encroachment.
Forestation
Forestation is a method being employed to check desert encroachment.
______ is an important source of vitamins and is therefore crucial to a balanced diet.
Tomato
Tomato is an important source of vitamins and is therefore crucial to a balanced diet.
